card.name: Dosing-interval abbreviations like Q2W
card.fires_on: The letter Q opening dosing-interval abbreviations such as Q2W or Q4W in parentheses after "every N weeks". It also fires on the ID of BID and on "than" in "not more frequently than".

modes.label: Q-interval abbreviation
modes.description: The Q that begins Q2W or Q4W after a stated every-N-weeks schedule.
modes.example: 300 mg given every 2 weeks (<<Q>>2W). Dosage in Pediatric Patients

modes.label: Frequency phrase
modes.description: Words ending a frequency limit or twice-daily abbreviation.
modes.example: * Not more frequently<< than>> every other day. CKD Stage

modes.label: BID abbreviation
modes.description: The ID piece of BID after a dose amount.
modes.example: effect of fluoxetine 20 mg B<<ID>> on the pharmacokinetics of estaz

card.writes: It pushes toward weekly and frequency words, suggesting the next text names a dosing frequency.
card.plain: It spots the start of a shorthand for how often a dose is given, like Q2W for every two weeks.
